ABOUT TEAM UNIVERSITY

Education that moves
you forward

TEAM University is a modern international business university in Tashkent, built to prepare ambitious people for the changing world of business.

Through Bachelor, MBA and Executive Education programs, we connect academic knowledge with practical experience, global perspectives and real business challenges.
